answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 20862 Country: Pakistan Title: I have a business of flour mill (Making flour from wheat).Can we mix RICE with it.Bec rice rate is low thn wheat and its also eatable comdity.Rice presntagr is also very low in this.Bt we dont tell this to our customer abt ths mixing. Question: Aslam.O.Aliqam I have a business of flour mill (Making flour from wheat).Can we mix RICE with it.Bec rice rate is low thn wheat and its also eatable comdity.Rice presntagr is also very low in this.Bt we dont tell this to our customer abt ths mixing. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 20862 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 569/377/L=1431) In case of mixing rice with wheat, it is necessary to tell the buyer; otherwise it would be deception. Hadith sternly warns those who deceive. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
